generation.explanation: A Riemann sum estimates the area under y = x² by splitting [0, 2] into n strips of width Δx = 2/n and adding up the areas of the rectangles, Σ f(xᵢ)·Δx. With left endpoints the rectangles sit under the rising curve, so the sum comes out too small. With right endpoints it comes out too big, and midpoints land very close. As n grows, all three approach the exact area, ∫₀² x² dx = 8/3 ≈ 2.6667. Use the slider to change n and the buttons to pick the sampling rule.
